description: Changes the title status pages show (public_title) or the root cause (Pro plans) of any incident, and the title, severity and monitors of one opened by hand. Fields left out keep their value. Free.

monitor_ids.description: The monitors it affects (GET /monitors): its updates show on the published status pages that show any of them. None or up to 50.

public_title.description: The title status pages show instead of the incident's own; null goes back to its own.

root_cause.description: What caused the incident (Pro plans); null clears it.

title.description: What the dashboard, alerts and status pages call it.

name: update_incident
title: Change an incident
